services.desc: Wing Foiling and/or Wing Surfing is one of the most exciting new developments in watersports worldwide. Winging combines the thrill of wind sports, such as windsurfing and kiteboarding, with the efficiency of hydrofoiling and the thrill of surfing to create a high-flying adrenaline rush. Winging requires riders to master the art of controlling their inflatable wing while riding a board with a hydrofoil attached. This new challenging yet rewarding activity will have you soaring over or in waves with very little effort required by the rider once mastered.
